videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences. The video is about the Seoul mayoral election reversal and Oh Se-hoon's victory, focusing on housing supply and redevelopment issues.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Oh Se-hoon won in 10 districts, particularly along the Han River belt (Gangnam area)
2. The victory was largely due to real estate sentiment (부동산 민심)
3. He won overwhelmingly in Gangnam 3 districts (Gangnam, Seocho, Songpa) and even expanded west to Yangcheon, Yeongdeungpo
4. Voters were concerned about disappearing jeonse (lease) supply, stagnant transactions, and tax bombs after the election
5. Even in Mapo where Jung Won-ho won overall, Oh won in high-end apartment areas like Gongdeok and Ahyeon
6. Apartment owners' anxiety about taxes and real estate policies drove votes
I need to summarize this in Korean, around 500 characters, 3-5 sentences, no English.
